roles.title: Geospatial Services & Data Analyst
roles.location: Lowell & Boston, MA · Los Angeles, CA · London, UK
bullets: Delivered geospatial analysis and data-driven figures for 75+ clients across power, utility, transportation, and renewable energy sectors, translating complex multi-dataset spatial problems into clear, actionable deliverables for project teams and stakeholders.

Partnered with clients, project managers, and engineers on a multi-state natural gas line planning effort spanning three southern U.S. states, building ArcGIS Pro Model Builder and Python workflows that automated geoprocessing and aligned distributed teams on a single consistent process.

Launched an interactive web application as the project GIS lead, improving spatial data sharing across 10 wetland scientists by integrating TRC, U.S. hydrological, parcel, and USDA soil & geological data layers to support new field projects.

Led a technical audit of a 20+ tool agentic GIS pipeline that classifies New York wetlands from a mapped area of interest, working with the client to benchmark tools against a revised state SOP and surface jurisdictional logic gaps and code defects.

roles.title: Data Analytics Intern
bullets: Cleaned and standardized field-collected data, resolving missing values and duplicate entries, then built groundwater chemical and soil composition tables in Excel and Power BI to support contamination response across 20+ project sites in the greater Boston region.

roles.title: GIS & Technical Services Intern
bullets: Collaborated with the VP of Transportation Compliance and GIS analysts to map hazardous waste removal trucking routes across New England with the ArcGIS Pro Network Analyst tool.

education.short: B.S. Environmental Science · Geospatial & Remote Sensing
education.field: Environmental Science, concentrating in Geospatial Analytics and Remote Sensing
